# Takomo Fitting Lab source attribution

Catalog copied unchanged from the user-supplied `TakomoGolf_SinceAI2026_FINAL.zip`, nested lab pack `takomo_official/takomo_products.json` (catalog dated 2026-10-13).

The fitting rules in `src/fitting.ts` adapt `takomo_fit/baseline.py` from Takomo Fitting Lab 1.1.0, copyright 2026 Since AI ry, MIT license reproduced in LICENSE. Corrections dated 5 November 2026 include head speed points, over-92 cap, forgiveness penalty, static lie approximation and midsize grips counting as stock. Missing-input handling, browser UI and SI conversion are implemented by Pocket Fitter.

Takomo's catalog is supplied for the hackathon; its separate conditions are reproduced in NOTICE. This snapshot does not establish live stock or validate a fit for a real player. No synthetic population is included in the deployed application.
